errors: No mathematical errors are visible; the page is a heavily corrected draft.

Indexing of the jumps: they are written b^(1), ..., b^(p). In the published version the cut system has 2p cross-cuts (plus auxiliary cuts), so either the indexing is provisional or only p of the cuts are meant. This is a notational point, not an error.

The existence of the minimizer is asserted on the basis of the Dirichlet principle without justification. This is the well-known gap later criticized by Weierstrass and repaired by Hilbert (1900/1904). It is consistent with Riemann's published 1857 argument.

results.what: Construction of a harmonic function u on the cut surface T' with prescribed constant jumps across the cross-cuts, by minimizing the Dirichlet integral over functions differing from a given alpha by a continuous function
results.modern_name: Dirichlet principle; existence of harmonic differentials / abelian integrals of the first kind with prescribed real periods
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann, Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen (1857), building on Dirichlet, Gauss, Thomson; rigorous version by Hilbert

results.what: Conjugate harmonic function v = ∫(u_x dy − u_y dx), single-valued on T' with constant jumps b^(nu) across the cuts; w = u + iv
results.modern_name: harmonic conjugate; periods of an abelian differential of the first kind

results.what: Extension of the method to functions with prescribed singular parts (logarithmic and polar) at given points
results.modern_name: existence of abelian integrals of the second and third kind via the Dirichlet principle

deep.surprise_reason: This is a working draft of the published existence section (§§3-4 and later) of Riemann's 1857 Abelian functions paper. The content is well known as his. The only interest is in seeing the drafting process and the reuse of a postal ledger sheet.

checkable.asserts: Trivial identity: the exterior derivative of u_x dy - u_y dx has coefficient d/dx(u_x) - d/dy(-u_y) = u_xx + u_yy, so the form is closed iff u is harmonic.

checkable.sympy: x,y=symbols('x y',real=True); u=log(x**2+y**2)/2; P=-diff(u,y); Q=diff(u,x); simplify(diff(Q,x)-diff(P,y))==0
checkable.asserts: For harmonic u the form P dx + Q dy = -u_y dx + u_x dy is closed (checked away from the origin).

checkable.sympy: x,y=symbols('x y',real=True); u=log(x**2+y**2)/2; v=atan2(y,x); simplify(diff(v,x)+diff(u,y))==0 and simplify(diff(v,y)-diff(u,x))==0
checkable.asserts: The conjugate obtained by integrating u_x dy - u_y dx satisfies the Cauchy-Riemann equations, so u + iv = log z is analytic. v jumps by the constant 2*pi across a cut, a model for the constant jumps b^(nu).

checkable.sympy: x,y=symbols('x y',real=True); u=x**3-3*x*y**2; v=3*x**2*y-y**3; simplify(diff(u,x)-diff(v,y))==0 and simplify(diff(u,y)+diff(v,x))==0
checkable.asserts: Example check that v = ∫(u_x dy - u_y dx) yields the harmonic conjugate.

transcription_corrections: The page is written over a printed ledger form: header 'No 10', columns 'Auslage', 'Porto', 'Franco' (Thlr/Sgr/Pf). This is not Riemann's text.
The formula line reads '∂u/∂x dy − ∂u/∂y dx' with a following 'dx' struck out, and 'vollständiges Differential' follows on the next line.

The line beginning 'Es sei v auf der positiven Seite der Querschnitte ...' reads in the image as 'Es sei v auf der positiven Seite der Querschnitte um b^(1), b^(2), ... b^(p) grösser'. The struck words are probably 'der Reihe nach'.
In the opening sentence the word above the line is probably 'völlig' (as in 'eine stetige Function α von x,y völlig ... so annehmen'), not a lacuna.

The last paragraph reads roughly 'Offenbar kann man nun in T eine Function α ... von x, y so annehmen, daß sie in T' ... stetig bleibt, ... wo ihr Differentialquotient ... untereinander stetig bleibt oder unstetig wird, einer gegebenen Function von x, y ...'. The final word on the page is probably 'Functionen von x, y' or 'z'.
